title: Impact of FDA Drug Approval on Biotech Company Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

For this research scenario, an Event Study approach is most suitable. The Event Study method is used to estimate the abnormal returns around a specific event, in this case, the FDA drug approval. The key assumption here is that the returns of the biotech companies are not systematically different from the market returns before the event. After the event, we expect to see a divergence in returns due to the FDA approval.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(plm)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s63_data.csv")

# Calculate the abnormal returns by subtracting the market returns
data$abn_ret <- data$ret - data$mkt_ret

# Create a factor for event day
data$event_day_factor <- factor(data$event_day, levels = c(-10:10))

# Estimate the model using fixed effects
model <- plm(abn_ret ~ event_day_factor, data = data, index = c("stock_id", "event_day"), model = "within")

# Calculate the coefficients for the event days
coefs <- coef(model)

# Calculate the cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) for the event window
car <- sum(coefs[-1])  # Exclude the intercept

# Print the CAR
print(car)

# Robustness check: Cluster-robust standard errors
vcovHC <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
coeftest(model, vcovHC)
```

## 3. Expected Findings

We expect the cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) to be positive around the FDA approval date. The magnitude of the effect will depend on the market's perception of the significance of the FDA approval for the biotech companies. If the approval is seen as a positive development, we would expect a larger positive CAR. The sign and magnitude of the CAR will provide insights into how the market reacts to regulatory events in the pharmaceutical sector.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Exploit the timing of FDA drug approval announcements as a natural experiment.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: FDA drug approvals lead to a positive change in biotech companies' CAR.
